== Summary ==
Identified: [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (grey-brown hair, black tee; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2025 European Championship 17.jpg]]), [[Tamás Papp]] (black graphic tee; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship 15.jpg]]), and [[Kevin Jaap]] (bald, white tee and glasses; same face as [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). Remaining: the front player in a white circular graphic tee and glasses; the player in a dark polo and glasses; and the heavy-set player in a beige shirt at the near end.


Players at dinner at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-09-26
* '''Identification:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (grey-brown hair, black tee; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2025 European Championship 17.jpg]]), [[Tamás Papp]] (black graphic tee; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship 15.jpg]]), and [[Kevin Jaap]] (bald, white tee and glasses; same face as [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). Remaining: the front player in a white circular graphic tee and glasses; the player in a dark polo and glasses; and the heavy-set player in a beige shirt at the near end.
